<!-- head-1: body_md -->
For each positive integer $N$, let $\mathbf{A}_N\in\mathbb{C}^{N\times N}$ be a random matrix with uniformly bounded spectral norm. Let $\mathbf{x}_N\in\mathbb{C}^{N}$ be a random vector of i.i.d. entries with zero mean, variance $1/N$, and independent of $\mathbf{A}_N$. Then
\begin{equation}
    \mathbf{x}_N^{\mathsf{H}} \mathbf{A}_n \mathbf{x}_N 
    - \frac{1}{N} \mathrm{tr} \mathbf{A}_N
    \overset{N\rightarrow\infty}{\longrightarrow}  0  ,
\end{equation}
almost surely.
<!-- end head-1 -->
<!-- head-2: body_md -->
The proof is given in~\cite{wagner_2012}. \hfill $\blacksquare$
<!-- end head-2 -->
<!-- head-3: body_md -->
Let $N$ and $\mathbf{x}_N$ be as in Lemma 1 and let $\mathbf{A}_N^{\mathfrak{D}},\mathbf{B}_N\in\mathbb{C}^{N\times N}$ be deterministic matrices with uniformly bounded spectral norm. Further, $\mathbf{A}_N^{\mathfrak{D}}$ is diagonal with positive entries and $\mathbf{B}_N$ is positive semidefinite. Then
\begin{equation}
\begin{split}
    \mathbf{x}_N^{\mathsf{H}} \mathbf{B}_N^{1/2} (\mathbf{A}_N^{\mathfrak{D}} \odot  (\mathbf{B}_N^{1/2} & \mathbf{x}_N \mathbf{x}_N^{\mathsf{H}}  \mathbf{B}_N^{1/2} ) ) \mathbf{B}_N^{1/2} \mathbf{x}_N - \\
    & \frac{2}{N^2} \mathrm{tr} \mathbf{B}_N ( \mathbf{A}_N^{\mathfrak{D}} \odot \mathbf{B}_N ) 
    \overset{N\rightarrow\infty}{\longrightarrow}  0  ,
\end{split}
\end{equation}
almost surely.
<!-- end head-3 -->
<!-- head-4: body_md -->
The proof is given in Appendix~\ref{appendix:lemma_2}.   \hfill $\blacksquare$
<!-- end head-4 -->
<!-- head-5: body_md -->
Consider a particular quadratic-over-linear ratio maximization problem with box constraints as
\begin{subequations}
    \begin{align}
    \max_{\{ s_r \}_{\forall r}} \quad & \frac{(\sum_{r} a_{r} s_{r} )^2}{ \sum_{r} b_{r} s_{r}  } \\
    \mathrm{s.t.}\quad\ & 0\le s_{r} \le 1 , \forall r  , 
\end{align}
\end{subequations}
where $a_r,b_r>0,\forall r$, and the objective defined as zero for the trivial solution when $s_r=0,\forall r$.
<!-- end head-5 -->
<!-- head-6: body_md -->
The proof is given in Appendix~\ref{appendix:lemma_3}.   \hfill $\blacksquare$
<!-- end head-6 -->
